title: Spring Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and healthy vegetarian side dish made with spring ingredients. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the spring onions and garlic and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the saffron and rice, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional spring onions if desired.
